journey.name: M7 activity badge, activity list, notification permission and deep links
journey.description: Signed in as journey.user (who has at least one post), app in the foreground, backend reachable, notification permission not yet granted (API 33+). After step 1 the harness comments on journey.user's latest post as journey.friend through the API. Before step 9 the harness runs `adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d insta://chat/journey.friend`.

actions.action: Verify that the Home screen is shown
Verify within 10 seconds, without any tap, that the "Activity" navigation item shows a badge for 1 new notification
Verify that the Activity screen lists "journey.friend commented: Nice shot from M7!" and that the "Activity" navigation item no longer shows a badge
Verify that a "Turn on notifications" card is shown and tap its "Turn on" button
Tap "Allow" in the system permission dialog
Verify that the "Turn on notifications" card is gone
Tap the "journey.friend commented: Nice shot from M7!" row and verify that the Comments screen shows "Nice shot from M7!"
Verify that the conversation with journey.friend is shown (opened by the deep link)
Tap the "Back" button and verify that the Messages screen is shown
